reuse.why: The transaction download generalises Akahu's downloader into a shared function and reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank and handleSyncResponse, but the link flow is a fresh copy of linkAkahuAccount rather than a shared link routine.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a ~70-line near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade/insert branches, payee creation, initial sync, sync-event), adding one more copy of the per-provider link block.

placement.why: Handler in accounts/app.ts, download and balance handling in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts and type under types/models, matching where each existing provider lives.

scope.why: Only the files needed for the server-side provider plus targeted tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The download side is well factored, but the copied link function means any future change to linking must be made in yet another place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing shared helpers (assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse); there is no shared link abstraction in the tree to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The linkFintegraAccount copy of linkAkahuAccount in accounts/app.ts is an open copy (only the provider string, orgId and tables list differ), not disguised.
